name: The Thinker
work_style: Exploratory and concept-driven. Need intellectual freedom to question assumptions. Work best on novel problems with no established answer. Deep diver who loses track of time when genuinely engaged.
energy_drains: Being forced to commit before thorough analysis
environment_needs: Problems at the frontier of a field
decision_making: Exhaustive analysis, sometimes to the point of paralysis. Need to acknowledge when 'good enough' data is available. Strong at identifying flaws in reasoning.
leadership_style: Lead through ideas and analysis. Reluctant leaders who excel in technical advisory roles over formal management.
